sentences.text: Cra No. 1575 of 2024
(Kedar Singh Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh ) Dated : 10-07-2025

Shri Shyam Murari
Bangur - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri H.S.Rathore, G.A. for State.

Heard on Ia No.16308/2024 which is first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for
suspension of jail sentence moved on behalf of sole appellant - Kedar Singh.

2.  The appellant has been convicted under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) of IPC and section 5(L)/6 and 5(J)(II)/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 3 years RI with fine of Rs.500/-, 5 years RI with fine of Rs.1000/-, 20 years RI with fine of Rs.15,000/-, 20 years RI with fine of Rs.15,000/- and 20 years RI with fine of Rs.15,000/- respectively with default stipulation.
3.
As per prosecution story, the prosecutrix was abducted by the appellant and thereafter she is alleged to be sexually exploited by the appellant.
4. Counsel for the appellant submits that as per testimony of the prosecutrix, she was a consenting party.
She herself had gone with the appellant and stayed with him for about 1 month.
Out of the said relationship, she got pregnant and she delivered a child.
The age of the prosecutrix has been proved by the Aadhar card without disclosing the source of information for recording Date of birth in the Aadhar card.
The appeal is of the year 2024 and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take 2 CRA-1575-2024 time.
In these circumstances, the jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
5. Counsel for the State opposed the prayer.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the testimony of the prosecutrix and also that source of recording date of birth of prosecutrix in the Aadhar card has not been proved by the prosecution, as per prosecution the age of prosecutrix was less than 16 years on the date of incident however the prosecution has not conducted any ossification test to prove the age of prosecutrix in absence of any scholar register.
Considering the aforesaid coupled with the fact that appeal being of the year 2024 is likely to take time for final hearing, we are of the view that the present application deserves to be allowed.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A No.16308/2024 is allowed.

The jail sentence of appellant - Kedar Singh is suspended upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 23/09/2025 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
7. With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed of.
CC as per rules.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) (PREM NARAY  JUDGE JUDG  3 CRA-1575-2024
